source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Μαΐου — «Όσιοι Φουγάτιος και Δαμιανός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and carries two head names, «Οσιος Δαμιανος» and «Οσιος Φουγατιος» — in that order, the reverse of the day line's — so it is two folders. It carries no asterisk. **There is no `dates` object for either of them**: the page gives a century and no year. Eleutherius of Rome, who sent them, has no folder and is named without a link. None of the corpus's eight men of this name is a second-century monk of Rome sent to England: `damian-of-rome`, `damian-the-healer`, `damian-of-asia`, `damian-of-agrafa`, `damian-of-esphigmenou` and `damian-disciple-of-polychronius` are all other men, and the display name keeps the mission because the page gives him nothing else.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
